title: Jonaz Productions is now MOONCREST GROUP
excerpt: The studio has a new name and a new logo. MLBClient and QuickClient continue as before, and the new game PROJECT: CITY LIFE takes over from Operation Iron Veil.
body:
From today, Jonaz Productions continues as **MOONCREST GROUP**, with a new name and a new logo.

## What changes

- **MLBClient** and **QuickClient** continue unchanged.
- **PROJECT: CITY LIFE** is our new game: a free open-world game set in San Cordova, a fictional coastal city inspired by Miami.
- **Operation Iron Veil** is no longer in development.

The Discord community and all project links stay the same.
